sophia_fin: Flagging invoice INV-2026-145 for Mariner Health. They report a burst overage during 2026-04-05 04:20-04:35 UTC while on Dedicated (25k reserved tokens). Can SRE verify if our routing caused duplicated requests?

ben_sales: Customer says client saw spikes and retries. CS ticket #CS-9401 opened. They want the overage removed if it was platform-caused.

maya_cs: Customer provided traces showing retries and a short time window of elevated traffic. They've paused automated retries. Link to logs in attachments.

eli_billing: Invoice shows `DED-BURST 2026-04-05 04:00-05:00: +15,600 tokens` (~$390). Reserved commit applied. Will hold any credits until SRE confirms.

invoice-bot: invoice INV-2026-145 posted for Mariner Health. Total due: $6,720. Overages: $390. Reserve: 25,000 tokens/month.

kai_sre: Quick look: at 04:22 UTC an internal router flapped during a control-plane rollout; duplicate forwarding observed for ~10 minutes. Preliminary duplicated-token estimate ~15,400. Opening incident SRE-2026-04-05-router-dup and will post a short postmortem.

ben_sales: Sounds like platform duplication. Customer asks for reversal + a short note about remediation.

sophia_fin: Action items: (1) SRE final delta, (2) CS confirm customer didn't trigger replays, (3) Billing prepare credit memo and proration if they changed commit.

maya_cs: Confirmed with Mariner: no load tests, only standard client retry behavior. They accept credit on next invoice.

kai_sre: Postmortem posted. Final duplicate-token count 15,612. Root cause: router rollout ordering bug; PR to prevent duplicate forwarding merged. ETA for full rollout: 48 hours.

eli_billing: Drafting CM-2026-022 referencing INV-2026-145 and CS-9401. Lines: `Reverse overage: -$392.00 (15,612 tokens)`. Note: customer reduced commit from 25k->20k on 2026-04-18; prorate for remaining 12 days will be applied as a separate credit on next invoice per their request.

zoe_vpfinance: Approve conditional on SRE postmortem and CS confirmation (both present). Add a customer-facing blurb: one-time goodwill credit due to platform duplication; no change to base pricing. Include incident link and ETA.

eli_billing: Finalized CM-2026-022: total credit -$392.00 + prorated reserve credit -$340.00 -> combined -$732.00 applied to next invoice. Marking INV-2026-145 disputed until posting.

ben_sales: I'll notify Mariner Health to expect the credit and follow up.

sophia_fin: Thanks everyone. Will close when credit posts and CS confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
